messages:
Maria (Sales): Quick heads-up — HorizonX wants to drop CompetitorX and run a 2-week POC to validate prompt parity + response stability. Can we scope? @Jonah (SE) you're SE lead right?
Jonah (SE): Yep, on it. Need model variant they use, typical prompt lengths, whether they rely on streaming/function-calling, and any special tokenization. Also confirm golden response sets.
Devin (AE): They're worried about price delta and rate limits. Currently on enterprise flat with 99.9% SLA. We should prepare a pricing bridge and a provisional committed capacity option.
Raj (HorizonX): We can share ~500 example prompts + expected outputs tonight. Major blockers: math/calc outputs differ, function-calls (named webhook payload shape), and slightly different tokenization causing prompt truncation.
Liz - Security: We can support VPC/private control plane, KMS/HSM, SOC2 docs, and audit log export for the POC. Send us their security questionnaire and we’ll pre-fill what we can.
Jonah (SE): Proposed POC plan:
- Week 0: kickoff + data ingest (prompts + golden responses)
- Week 1: parity testing (A/B vs CompetitorX) — metrics: embedding sim, response overlap, hallucination rate on eval set
- Week 2: load/latency + canary rollouts, iterate on prompt shim
Acceptance criteria suggestion: <=5% relative increase in hallucinations, median latency <= competitor + 50ms for same model class.
Maria (Sales): I'll draft a short SOW and pricing addendum for a 2-week eval. @Devin, can you do a rough hosted vs dedicated estimate so I can share with them?
Devin (AE): Quick back-of-envelope: if they run 50k tokens/day for 14 days, hosted usage ~700k tokens. At our hosted tier that's approx ~$1.2k for the POC (pro-rated) — Dedicated pricing needs quote but we'd offer a short-term burst plan. I'll follow up with exact numbers.
Jonah (SE): Quick example to map competitor endpoint to Redwood (demo only):
```
# competitor
curl -X POST https://api.compx/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello","max_tokens":50}'
# redwood
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"Hello","max_output_tokens":50}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>'
```
We should include a thin compat shim to translate param names and handle streaming frames.
Raj (HorizonX): Thanks — I’ll upload prompts and sample responses by EOD. Also attach the security questionnaire in this thread.
deploy-bot: canary/compat-shim-demo deployed to demo.redwood — health: OK :white_check_mark:
Maria (Sales): Great, let’s sync Thurs 10am PT with Horizon infra + security. I’ll send the invite and attach the SOW draft. :calendar:
Jonah (SE): I'll prepare the eval harness and a small script to compute embedding similarity and hallucination detection.
Liz - Security: Once we have the questionnaire I’ll mark any must-haves and flag onshore hosting options.
Devin (AE): Keeping this thread for pricing + legal notes. Will add cost breakdown tomorrow.
Raj (HorizonX): Awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
